goal: Make the repository and its current documentation reproduce the reviewed runtime truth: a formal Active Manifest or an unavailable/invalid Manifest state must prevent automatic SimC runtime switching, the Active health payload must expose its bound SimC revision, and the 2026-08-28 route, S2 and cloud-cleanup state must be recorded without promoting Candidate or partial evidence.
userValue: Players and operators are protected from a scheduled SimC runtime drifting away from the formal Active Manifest, while the repository, roadmap and deployment runbook describe the code and cloud state that actually exist.
nonGoals: Do not switch the Active Manifest, build or promote a new SimC runtime, trigger sync jobs, change timer cadence, migrate PostgreSQL, or mutate production data.
Do not claim that HTTP 200, automated tests, route parity, cloud cleanup or a dormant Candidate makes global data health green or current UI acceptance complete.
Do not add a fifteenth route, change the active Taro navigation, deploy frontend code, or reopen historical S2 execution plans.
Do not perform additional broad cloud deletion; retain formal evidence, approved PostgreSQL recovery points, Exact-first foundation and Active/Candidate/rollback runtimes.

currentTruth.factOwner: PostgresCacheStore active_manifest health owns formal pointer and dependency facts; data_health_followup may schedule only actions that remain safe under that owner state.

mustChange: Expose dependencyRevisions.simcRuntimeRevision in the active_manifest health component.
Select the SimC revision only from a component that actually reports updateAvailable=true.
Allow automatic SimC update only for an explicitly trusted inactive Manifest mode; formal, missing or invalid Manifest state must remain report-only.
Reconcile current project state, roadmap, plan index, 14-route mapping, S2 Active/Candidate boundary, database migration state and cloud-cleanup runbook.
mustNotChange: Active Manifest generation 41 and its f50a SimC dependency remain unchanged.
Systemd unit definitions, timer cadence, PostgreSQL rows, sync state, public route count and frontend behavior remain unchanged.
The 30555 freshness result remains dormant Candidate evidence and global data health remains literal partial.
riskUnknown: A missing or invalid active_manifest component could otherwise be mistaken for permission to update SimC.
Both SimC health components may exist while only one reports an update, so selecting by component presence can bind the wrong revision.
The production directory contains non-runtime files from an older Git base even when the reviewed runtime subset matches current source.
evidenceRequired: RED/GREEN regression tests for formal, missing, invalid and trusted inactive Active Manifest states plus multi-component SimC revision selection.
Targeted data-health/PostgreSQL tests, project-state/Harness tests, UI route architecture audit, JSON/link/whitespace checks and the repository full verification profile.
One immutable PR-head candidate smoke against the live health payload without --execute, with runtime hash, service, timer/backflow and rollback evidence.
GitHub CI and review results followed by local main/origin/main SHA parity.

ownership.factOwner: server/postgres_cache_store.py owns the active Manifest health projection; server/data_health_followup.py consumes that projection and owns only the bounded action plan.

engineeringHealth.reason: The change touches scheduled action planning and the PostgreSQL read-model hotspot, but performs no write, network fetch, SimC build or runtime switch; targeted tests and candidate dry-run cover the mutation boundary.

acceptanceEvidence: Formal Active Manifest with updateAvailable=true produces no SimC action and reports active_manifest_cutover_required.
Missing or invalid Active Manifest state produces no SimC action and reports active_manifest_state_unavailable.
Trusted pre_cutover/transitional state can still use the revision from the health component that reports the update.
The active_manifest health payload includes its bound simcRuntimeRevision.
Current docs distinguish 14-route source parity from UI acceptance, generation 41 Active from 30555 Candidate, and cloud cleanup from a reproducible Git deployment identity.

decisionLog.decision: The user approved reconciling the local uncommitted work with the configured project remote after the current-state and cloud-cleanup audit.
Local CR found that missing/invalid Manifest state and multi-component revision selection were not fail closed; TDD regression coverage is required before remote submission.

harnessFindings.whatHappened: The initial uncommitted guard blocked automatic SimC update only when formalActiveManifest was exactly true and selected a revision from the first present component.
harnessFindings.missedGate: Scheduled action owner-state availability and matching update source
harnessFindings.impact: A missing or invalid Manifest health component could permit runtime drift, and two present components could bind the wrong update revision.
harnessFindings.recommendedAction: Require a trusted inactive pointer mode before scheduling and select only a component that reports updateAvailable=true.
